title: Parameter Estimation of Ringdown Quasinormal Modes with Autoencoder
abstract: arXiv:2609.14277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ringdown gravitational waves from binary black hole mergers can be modeled as superpositions of quasinormal modes (QNMs), whose frequencies and excitation factors encode properties of the remnant Kerr black hole. Reliable extraction of multiple QNM components is challenging because of mode overlap and noise. We develop an autoencoder-based framework for multi-component QNM analysis, in which the latent space is trained to represent the physical parameters of individual modes, enabling waveform denoising and parameter estimation within a common framework. Using controlled model waveforms constructed as finite sums of Kerr QNMs with recently established high-precision frequencies and excitation factors, including their nontrivial spin dependence near resonant excitation, we assess the method across partitioned spin intervals. translated_title: 基于自编码器的铃宕准正则模参数估计
translated_abstract: 来自双黑洞并合的铃宕引力波可以建模为准正则模（QNMs）的叠加，其频率和激发因子编码了残余Kerr黑洞的性质。由于模式重叠和噪声的存在，可靠地提取多个QNM分量具有挑战性。我们开发了一个基于自编码器的多分量QNM分析框架，其中潜空间被训练用于表示单个模式的物理参数，从而在统一框架内实现波形去噪和参数估计。利用由Kerr QNMs有限和构造的受控模型波形——采用最近建立的高精度频率和激发因子，包括其在共振激发附近非平凡的自旋依赖性——我们在分区的自旋区间上评估了该方法。该模型对寿命最长的两个分量实现了良好的域内波形重建和参数恢复。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于自编码器的框架，通过将潜空间训练为表示单个准正则模的物理参数，在统一框架内实现铃宕引力波多模分量的波形去噪与参数估计。
en_tdlr: An autoencoder-based framework is developed in which the latent space represents physical parameters of individual quasinormal modes, enabling unified waveform denoising and parameter estimation for multi-component ringdown gravitational wave analysis.
